terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to Dolphin ERP. By accessing and using our software, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Use.
terms.acceptance: By registering and using Dolphin ERP, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted these terms. If you disagree, you must not use our services.
terms.service: Dolphin ERP is a SaaS platform providing billing, accounting, and ERP tools for businesses. The service is provided as is and as available.
terms.obligations: You are responsible for keeping your account and password confidential. You must immediately notify Dolphin ERP of unauthorized use and may not use the platform for illegal or fraudulent activities.
terms.intellectual: All rights, title, and interest in Dolphin ERP software, including source code, design, logos, and interfaces, belong exclusively to Dolphin ERP and are protected by intellectual property laws.
terms.liability: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Dolphin ERP is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including lost profits or data.
terms.modifications: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time. We will notify you of significant changes through the platform or email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Dolphin ERP, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal data you share with us.
privacy.collection: We collect information you provide directly when registering, updating your profile, or contacting support, including:
privacy.contact: Contact data: Name, email address, and company name.
privacy.billing: Billing data: Address and Tax ID. Dolphin ERP does not store credit card numbers.
privacy.usage: Usage data: Activity logs, IP address, browser, and device information.
privacy.use: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve services, process transactions, send technical and administrative notices, and answer support questions.
privacy.sharing: We do not sell or rent personal information. We may share data with service providers that need access to perform services on our behalf under confidentiality agreements.
privacy.security: We implement technical and organizational safeguards against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.rights: You may access, correct, update, or request deletion of your personal information from account settings or by contacting support.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Dolphin ERP uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you and improve the platform.
cookies.what: Cookies are small data files placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website or use an application.
cookies.why: We use first-party and third-party cookies for several reasons:
cookies.essential: Essential cookies: Strictly necessary to provide platform services and secure areas.
cookies.performance: Performance and analytics cookies: Help us understand platform usage and campaign effectiveness.
cookies.functionality: Functionality cookies: Remember settings and choices such as language and theme.
cookies.payment: External payment providers may set essential cookies to process transactions securely, prevent fraud, and comply with PCI-DSS.
cookies.control: You may accept or reject non-essential cookies through your browser preferences. Rejecting essential cookies may affect platform functionality.

subscription.title: Subscription Agreement
subscription.intro: This Subscription Agreement governs the terms under which you contract Dolphin ERP software services.
subscription.plans: Dolphin ERP offers monthly and annual plans. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the renewal date.
subscription.payments: The security of your financial data is our priority. Dolphin ERP does not collect, process, or store credit card numbers.
subscription.providers: We use PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment service providers.
subscription.tokenization: Transactions use tokenization so our system receives only an irreversible identifier.
subscription.prices: We may adjust service prices. Changes will be notified at least 30 days in advance and take effect in the next billing cycle.
subscription.cancellation: You may cancel at any time from account settings. Cancellation stops future charges but does not create prorated refunds unless required by law.
subscription.suspension: If automatic payment fails after multiple attempts, we may temporarily suspend premium features until the outstanding balance is resolved.
